status: final for the research pass; weights are judgment informed by the cited evidence (no source measures referral share by source). Not yet re-ranked on a live result set.

score.note: plain sum of factor points, rounded, capped at 100

tiers.label: Later
tiers.target_per_month: only if A and B are empty

factors.note: psychiatry is new (taxonomy 2084P0800X). Its code family also holds neurology, so match the primary code, not the word. Not in NPPES at all: school and college counselors, EAPs, clergy, attorneys. Add them by hand or from other lists as 'manual' sources, default 18.
factors.reason_template: {specialtyLabel} offices see people who need talk therapy and often have no one to send them to.

factors.rule: max minus per_mile times miles, never below 0
factors.note: Straight-line miles between ZIP centroids (Census ZCTA gazetteer, public domain). Existing code uses 30 and 6 per mile; this keeps the same shape. For rural states set per_mile to 1.5.
A letter to a named clinician gets read; a letter to a big group's front desk rarely does. NPPES lists an authorized official for organizations (NPI-2).
factors.reason_template: You can write to a named person ({name}) rather than a front desk.

factors.note: Fax counts: medical offices send and receive referrals by fax. NPPES has no email. Mailing-address-only phone numbers are often billing lines, so score the LOCATION address only.

factors.flag_text: Record last updated {year}; confirm they still practice before writing.

factors.note: Live check found providers whose mailing address is Chicago but whose LOCATION is in another state. Use the LOCATION address.

relationship_modifiers.note: Applied after the sum. Values come from the pipeline board, not NPPES.

reasons.warm_intro_available: You know someone who can introduce you.
reasons.sent_us_a_referral_before: They have sent you a client before: thank them and keep the line open.

nppes_gives: primary and secondary NUCC taxonomy plus license number and state
LOCATION and MAILING address, phone, fax
authorized official name, title, phone (organizations only)
endpoints (Direct addresses) when the provider registered one; empty for most
nppes_does_not_give: accepting new patients or accepting referrals
patient volume, age mix or what they actually refer
which practice or hospital a person works for (no reliable link between NPI-1 and NPI-2)
whether the record is still true: records can be 15+ years old
hard_rules: No factor, reason or modifier may reward or offer anything of value for a referral. No gifts, no paid placement, no per-referral pricing.
Reason text states facts about the source, never a promise about what they will send.
Never mention a client to a source without that client's written consent.

evidence_refs.claim: General medical sector treats 22.8% of treated adults but gives minimally adequate care 12.7% vs 48.3% in specialty
Pediatricians agree they should treat ADHD (70%) but under one third agree they should treat other mental health problems
Psychotherapy share of psychiatrist visits fell from 44.4% to 28.9%
Perinatal referral uptake pooled 43%; on-site 60% vs outside service 32%
80.8% of college counseling centers cannot meet demand; 28.1% refer more students off campus
66.8% of PCPs had trouble getting outpatient mental health services; access and coverage top reasons
Referrals often pass through the office manager or front desk; mailed letters often discarded
Thank referrers, confirm each referral, set reminders to re-contact quiet sources
Anti-Kickback Statute: remuneration to induce or reward referrals is a felony for federal program business
Illinois 740 ILCS 92/5 bars remuneration to induce procuring patients for insurance-billed services
